request: Replace the rejected UI with a modern, simple, intuitive action workspace, supporting narrow/sidebar and full display. All application-authored UI copy must be English.

problems: An empty detail card occupies a permanent third column.
Multiple cards, badges and diagnostic rows compete with action titles.
Narrow layout becomes a stacked form rather than a focused workspace.
Incomplete actions use the same checked icon as completed actions.
Japanese and English UI copy are mixed.

visual_direction.name: Quiet action workspace
visual_direction.canvas: white content surface with a faint neutral navigation rail and near-black text; dark mode uses equally quiet neutral surfaces
visual_direction.accent: one restrained indigo accent for primary action, selection and active flags
visual_direction.typography: system sans; 28px scope heading in full display, 23px narrow; 14px regular row titles; clear secondary 12px metadata
visual_direction.shape: continuous app shell, restrained 6-8px controls, separators rather than nested cards, no decorative gradients or shadows
visual_direction.rows: 52-60px natural rows, unchecked completion circle for unfinished actions, selected state background, metadata as subdued text, optional direct flag at trailing edge
visual_direction.icons: consistent 18-20px stroke SVG family, no raster assets; decorative SVGs aria-hidden; icon controls have English accessible names
visual_direction.wide: 200-220px pale navigation rail, flexible action list; 320-380px right detail panel only while selected; empty detail space is reclaimed
visual_direction.narrow: one canvas, compact top toolbar, clear scope picker, action list fills available width; selecting an action opens an inline detail region before the list, with Back to list and keyboard focus return
visual_direction.narrow_alternative_rejected: Modal bottom sheet adds focus/scroll/unknown-review overlay complexity. Inline detail is simpler, supports long nine-field proposals and existing review dialog without nested modal behavior.
visual_direction.secondary_content: Capture notes, organization, Defer, lifecycle and diagnostics stay behind labeled progressive disclosures; remove idle technical text from the primary surface
visual_direction.containment: Subtle bounded indent for child rows, plus subdued parent context when relevant; cap indentation to protect narrow widths. Preserve authoritative parent-first saved order; never infer hierarchy from title.

english_contract.authored_copy: English across labels, placeholders, accessibility names, empty/loading states, status/errors, confirmation dialogs, capture, lifecycle, display-mode messages, diagnostics, page metadata and preview iframe title.
english_contract.document_language: en for both widget and web layout
english_contract.dates: English locale, explicit client timezone where date interpretation matters; retain exact UTC instants and English before/after review.
english_contract.user_data: Never translate stored titles, notes, project/tag names or parent titles.
english_contract.error_boundary: Map typed API/transport error codes to English UI messages. Do not display backend message strings directly. Unknown codes use an English fallback. Preserve exact request recovery semantics.
english_contract.preview_warnings: Translate known warning codes to English; never insert raw server warning.message. User-authored affected titles remain exact.
english_contract.host_metadata: English tool titles and UI resource names/descriptions in app/mcp/route.ts; runtime assistance conversation policy is unchanged.

flows.exit: Current view and its action titles are visible
flows.given: A full display has no selected action
flows.then: The list takes the available content width and no empty detail card is shown
flows.counterexample: A blank editor reserves one third of the content area.

flows.exit: The selected action can be edited and the list remains reachable
flows.given: The app is narrow or in a sidebar
flows.then: Its detail region is brought into view, title receives focus, and Back to list is available
flows.counterexample: Details are appended far below a long list without a direct return route.

flows.entry: An English navigation scope is visible
flows.exit: The chosen authoritative scope is shown
flows.when: The user selects Inbox, Flagged, On hold, Later, Completed or Dropped
flows.then: Scope labels, heading and empty state are English and selection reflects the authoritative scope
flows.counterexample: A renamed scope changes domain filtering or hides on-hold actions from normal view.

flows.exit: The completion proposal describes its actual effects
flows.given: An action is active or on-hold
flows.when: The user examines and activates its completion control
flows.then: The control appears unchecked before saving and the existing review describes affected descendants
flows.counterexample: Every incomplete row already displays a checkmark.

flows.exit: Edits remain reachable after refresh, scope change or display switch
flows.given: One or more of the nine draft fields differ from saved values
flows.when: The host refreshes, the view changes or display mode switches
flows.then: Unsaved values and exact input formatting remain; out-of-view proposals have an English access control
flows.counterexample: A scope switch or responsive layout erases a date, order, flag or IME input.

flows.exit: The original request can be checked or identically retried
flows.given: A submitted write has an unknown outcome
flows.then: An English recovery message offers Check result and Retry same request; unrelated writes remain blocked
flows.counterexample: The UI says Save failed or retries with a new operation ID.

flows.entry: The user reviews dates or backend validation feedback
flows.exit: Meaning and safe recovery are clear in English
flows.given: The server returns a known error or date warning
flows.then: The UI presents English meaning without backend Japanese and preserves exact before/after fields and timezone
flows.counterexample: Raw warning.message or error.message appears in the interface.

flows.entry: A row flag control is available
flows.exit: The direct flag proposal is accessible
flows.given: The user uses keyboard, mouse or touch
flows.then: The unflagged control is available on hover/focus and always available on touch; a set flag remains visible
flows.counterexample: Opacity-only styling leaves an unreachable control or hides a set flag.

technical_contracts.ears: The UI shall preserve the existing nine-field draft, operation ID, exact arguments, revision, preview, replay and Undo contracts while changing presentation and language.
When no action is selected, the workspace shall omit the detail column from layout.
technical_contracts.implementation: CSS selection class/data attribute driven by existing selection; no domain changes.

technical_contracts.ears: When a narrow viewport selects an action, the DOM adapter shall focus its title and show the existing editor before the list, exposing a return control.
technical_contracts.implementation: Reuse the existing editor node and draft controller; retain event handlers, IME/caret logic and review focus restoration.

technical_contracts.ears: When a known error or warning reaches the UI, pure presentation functions shall map its code to English recovery text.
technical_contracts.implementation: English mapping in pure model, explicitly included in widget serialization model; effect adapters never render raw server messages.

technical_contracts.ears: When display context changes, the UI shall preserve drafts and trust reported host displayMode rather than derive it from width.
technical_contracts.implementation: Retain mergeHostContext and display bridge version-race behavior; responsiveness is independent from host mode.

technical_contracts.ears: The UI shall remain usable at widths 320, 380, 640 and 1440 pixels without horizontal document overflow.
technical_contracts.verification: Browser screenshots and DOM bounds for populated and selected-detail states.

technical_contracts.ears: The UI shall expose English accessible names, visible focus and keyboard paths for every control.
technical_contracts.verification: DOM assertions and actual focus interactions; touch flag visibility via coarse-pointer rule.

implementation_order: Audit every UI and transport message/code/warning and add pure English presentation mapping.
Replace the shell, hierarchy, navigation, row styling, icons and selected-only detail layout.
Wire compact return-to-list/focus behavior, preserving drafts and review recovery.
Update English metadata/lang and UI assertions.
Run pnpm check and pnpm build; verify built UI and actual screenshots in full/narrow light/dark, then independent native review.
verification: English authored-copy scan does not mistake saved Japanese fixture data for UI text.
Nine-field draft retention, IME/caret, per-group acknowledgement and dropped-parent option tests remain meaningful.
Unknown outcome while a review dialog is open offers reachable recovery.
Preview review includes exact before/after for cleared and empty values and preserves date-only 09:00 semantics.
Host display notification/request race cannot reset proposals.
Use visual evidence for the new source; old screenshots and old approval are historical only.
English visual sample data includes Plan next week, Review landing page and Book dentist; separate Japanese raw-text fixtures establish exact preservation.
limitations: This native author candidate is not a runtime-kernel SUCCEEDED receipt.
Local browser evidence cannot establish actual ChatGPT Work host acceptance.
Visual success must be assessed on new screenshots; the user's rejection remains authoritative for the old UI.
